title: Ballet Dance Teaching Preparation and Performance
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Ballet Dance Teaching Preparation and Performance
outcomes: GLOBAL COMMUNICATION: Students will be able to analyze, write and speak about historical, theoretical and cultural dimensions of multiple dance genres within a greater global context that reflects diverse, cultural perspectives.
DANCE MECHANICS: Students will develop anatomical awareness within the realm of personal movement possibilities for efficient and sustainable body maintenance.

TEACHER PREPARATION: Successful students will examine, synthesize, and evaluate teaching methods of modern dance through critical dance pedagogy with a focus on arts activism and dance as a tool for social justice.

notes: The catalog text begins mid-sentence and prints no section heading; the program title is used as section_heading.

Catalog prints zero-padded codes (DANCE 001, DANCE 006, DANCFOLK 009, DANCE 061, DANCE 062) that match closed-list DANCE 1, DANCE 6, DANCFOLK 9, DANCE 61, DANCE 62; treated as the same courses, not catalog additions.

Careers taken from the Career Opportunities sentence 'careers in K-post secondary education dance programs, professional, and other arts related professions'; the text also says students will be prepared to teach in dance studios, recreation or afterschool settings and performance companies, which describes settings rather than named job titles.
Program learning outcomes are recorded with their printed labels (GLOBAL COMMUNICATION:, etc.) as part of the outcome text.
